title: 类型与 %T
summary: 用 %T 打印多个基础类型变量的实际类型。
license: Original QFLI curriculum; reference link retained. CC BY 4.0
code:
package main

import "fmt"

func main() {
	var i8 int8 = 127
	var u8 uint8 = 255
	var f float64 = 3.5
	var b bool = true
	var s string = "go"
	fmt.Printf("%T=%v %T=%v %T=%v %T=%v %T=%q\n", i8, i8, u8, u8, f, f, b, b, s, s)
	// 类型推断：值决定默认类型。
	typed := 10
	fmt.Printf("typed 是 %T\n", typed)
}
expectedOutput:
int8=127 uint8=255 float64=3.5 bool=true string="go"
typed 是 int

title: iota 枚举

license: Original QFLI curriculum; reference link retained. CC BY 4.0
code:
package main

import "fmt"

type Weekday int

const (
	Sunday Weekday = iota
	Monday
	Tuesday
)

func main() {
	fmt.Println(int(Sunday), int(Monday), int(Tuesday))
	const pi = 3.14159 // 无类型常量，使用时才确定类型
	var f float64 = pi
	fmt.Printf("pi as float64 = %.2f\n", f)
}
expectedOutput:

pi as float64 = 3.14

title: 显式转换与截断
summary: 演示 int/float 显式转换、int64 到 int32 的截断与浮点取整。
license: Original QFLI curriculum; reference link retained. CC BY 4.0
code:
package main

import "fmt"

func main() {
	var i int = 3
	var f float64 = float64(i) // 显式转换
	big := int64(1 << 40)
	small := int32(big) // 截断，保留低位
	fmt.Println(i, f)
	fmt.Printf("big=%d small=%d\n", big, small)
	// 浮点到整数会丢弃小数部分（向零取整）；常量 3.9 不能直接转 int，
	// 必须先放进 float64 变量再转换。
	var x float64 = 3.9
	fmt.Printf("trunc(3.9)=%d\n", int(x))
}

title: 截取与 append 的共享陷阱
summary: 演示截取共享底层数组以及 append 写回源切片。
license: Original QFLI curriculum; reference link retained. CC BY 4.0
code:
package main

import "fmt"

func main() {
	base := []int{1, 2, 3, 4, 5}
	view := base[1:3] // 与 base 共享底层数组
	view[0] = 99
	fmt.Println("base", base)
	fmt.Println("view", view)

	appended := append(view, 100) // 容量足够时写回共享数组
	fmt.Println("appended", appended)
	fmt.Println("base after append", base)
}
expectedOutput:
base [1 99 3 4 5]
view [99 3]
appended [99 3 100]
base after append [1 99 3 100 5]
